summary: Iteration 2 backend+frontend regression. 22/23 pytest cases passed (23 collected). All 10 sidebar modules load; Fleet renders 8 vehicle cards (>=6 required); vehicle detail Share modal + public /public/vehicle/:token portal work; 8/8 investigate/{key} API endpoints return 200; InvestigationPanel opens for all 8 KPI cards with rows+total (verified). Drivers CRUD works when email is filled. TWO REAL BUGS FOUND: (1) /api/auth/login does NOT accept recovery codes (spec violation) — recovery-code login returns 401 'Invalid 2FA code'; (2) Drivers POST returns 422 when frontend sends empty-string email (Pydantic EmailStr rejects '').

critical.issue: Login endpoint only validates TOTP via pyotp; never checks user.recovery_codes. Recovery-code login returns 401 'Invalid 2FA code'. Spec required accepting a recovery code (>=8 chars) in place of the 6-digit TOTP and returning {user, token, recovery_used: true}, and marking the code as used. Currently recovery codes are generated but unusable — 2FA lockout risk if user loses authenticator.

Returns 422 when payload has email='' (empty string). Pydantic EmailStr does not accept empty string; frontend Drivers.jsx sends {email: ''} by default. Either coerce '' -> null in backend or send null/omit from frontend.

ui_bugs.issue: Save fails silently with 'Failed' toast when email field is left blank. Should either mark email as required in UI or send null so backend accepts it.

integration_issues.issue: Backend rejects recovery code at /api/auth/login so the entire recovery-code UX (Security page) is non-functional even though recovery codes are generated and displayed.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' caused by dynamic-instrumentation span injected inside <option>. Not user-visible but pollutes console.

action_items: Backend: modify /api/auth/login to accept recovery codes. Suggested logic: after totp.verify fails, check user.recovery_codes for an unused entry matching req.code (case-insensitive); on match mark used=true, return {user, token, recovery_used: true}. Reuse must return 401. Also treat len(req.code)>=8 (not 6 digits) as recovery-code path.
Backend or Frontend: fix Drivers POST 422 for empty email. Either accept email:'' as null server-side, or in /app/frontend/src/pages/Drivers.jsx send email: form.email || null when posting.
Optional: strip dynamic-instrumentation <span> injection inside <option> children in Drivers.jsx d-vehicle select to silence React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login() (line 362-376) only calls pyotp.TOTP().verify(); no branch for recovery codes despite recovery_codes[] being stored on the user document. Directly contradicts feature spec.
DriverIn.email is Optional[EmailStr] but frontend always sends '' — should be Optional[EmailStr] = None with an @validator converting '' to None, OR the frontend should convert.
server.py is 1656 lines — recommend splitting (routers/auth.py, routers/drivers.py, routers/investigate.py, etc.) to satisfy 700-line guideline.
sidebar link path is /audit but review-request referenced /activity — confirm labelling consistency (label 'Activity' -> path /audit is intentional, fine).
Drivers.jsx form does not mark email as required in UI but backend rejects '' — mismatched contract.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all modules + fleet + share + KPI panel + driver CRUD verified; only failing UX is empty-email driver save)

rca_of_the_issue: Recovery-code login RCA: In /app/backend/server.py lines 368-373, the login handler only calls pyotp.TOTP(user['totp_secret']).verify(req.code, valid_window=1). No lookup against user['recovery_codes'] exists. The 2FA setup/enable/regenerate flow correctly persists recovery codes in the user doc, but the consumption code path is missing entirely. Repro: 1) enable 2FA, 2) capture a recovery code from /auth/2fa/enable response, 3) POST /auth/login with {email,password,code:RECOVERY_CODE} — expected 200+recovery_used=true, actual 401 Invalid 2FA code. Mitigation: extend login() to fall through to recovery-code check when TOTP verify fails and len(req.code)>=8, then $set the matching recovery_codes[i].used=true and return recovery_used:true. Drivers 422 RCA: Pydantic EmailStr rejects '' — the frontend default form state (Drivers.jsx line 24) initializes email:'' and posts it unmodified; fix in either layer as above.
